previous_findings.resolution: Round 0 was the orchestrator requirement-alignment placeholder (round=0, not an independent verdict). This independent round-1 gate confirms it resolved: the rewritten design.md is a coherent progressive-streaming contract. The path-only non-streaming contract, completion-gated oracle, and path-only proto/app/infra/tests are fully replaced (§1, §2, §5-§9, §11-§13); owner rejection of path-only and completion-gating is honored throughout; all superseded artifacts retained under review/path-only.

assumptions_for_human_review: Dependency accuracy independently verified against pinned go-tdlib v0.7.6 (module cache, go.mod:17) and native TDLib 22d49d5b87a4d5fc60a194dab02dd1d71529687f. All four §6 adapter signatures match the SDK verbatim: DownloadFile (function.go:11911-11925, already present at revision baseline 518bfcc — client_adapter.go:57,369), GetFile (function.go:1609-1615), GetFileDownloadedPrefixSize (function.go:11949-11957) returning FileDownloadedPrefixSize{Size int64}, ReadFilePart (function.go:12187-12197) returning FilePart{Data []byte}. Design's 'DownloadFile already exists; add the other three' claim is factually correct.

Terminal/EOF oracle grounded in native source, not guessed: FileManager.cpp:1046-1050 (LocalFileLocation::Full returns size_-offset, 0 at/past EOF; SecureEncrypted Partial returns 0 until verified) supports §7.4's 'unknown size drained to completion via complete-state prefix=0' rule; FileManager.cpp:2861 confirms read_file_part verifies the requested range against downloaded_prefix. No unsupported guarantee (e.g. claiming bytes TDLib has not made readable) is asserted.

Both new RPCs are replaced in place, not duplicated: fbc22cc has exactly 15 RPCs; revision baseline 518bfcc has 17 (GetMessageFile unary + DownloadFile unary added). Design §2/§5/§10 remove the two unreleased unary messages/methods and replace them with streaming contracts, satisfying R7 while preserving all 15 public-main RPCs. 'Generated changes need not be additions-only' in §10 is scoped and correct.

D4 decision traceability: every design decision traces to a PRD requirement (R1-R9/A1-A8), a spec clause (telegram-tdlib-guidelines live-consumer rule; quality-guidelines strict-mock/synctest), or is [ASSUMPTION]-marked. Marked assumptions are sound and cost-guarded: polling-vs-subscription (§1), fixed constants 256KiB/250ms/priority16 (§1), synchronous emit callback / no producer goroutine / no queue (§4), TDLib owns cache / no upstream CancelDownloadFile / no refcount (§4), wire field numbers (§5), chunk.upstream_complete as sample-not-oracle (§5), app DTO shape (§6), photo/MIME conventions (§6), stopped-inactive=fail (§7.6), and CI script mutation anchor (§10). No unmarked decision found.

D6 coverage: each A1-A8 has a concrete mechanical landing point and falsifiability. A1 decisive pre-completion barrier (§9, bufconn, real Service+Transport+generated client, chunk-before-release assertion) is causally ordered and cannot pass for a completion-gated impl. A2 ordered/bounded prefix + backpressure (block emit -> no further reads). A3 cancel/deadline/two-consumer-same-file (§4 no upstream cancel, §9). A4 unknown/empty/final-size/inactive/short-read deterministic terminals (§7.4-7.6, §9). A5 media/MIME mappings (§6 table, field spellings re-verified). A6 generation byte-identity + fbc22cc descriptor compare. A7 Linux vet/test + executed A1 red/green. A8 acceptance client + publish gating. All mechanically falsifiable.

D7 spec/boundary consistency: transport->app->infra direction preserved (§4); app must not import pb/gRPC, infra must not import app/pb; no reverse edges or test-only production hooks. Existing NoBusinessUpdates + shared receiver untouched; no new unconsumed queue/listener (§4, R5). Client-selectable photo variant remains a non-goal (N8-equivalent, §6 largest-photo [ASSUMPTION]). CI scope is one script + one invocation in the existing ci-test.yml (§10), with explicit 'keep pins/cache/build/triggers unchanged' — not a build/pin/trigger change.

Honest SDK limitation handled without overclaiming: §1 and §8 state SDK calls are non-context-aware and an in-flight Send can persist to the ~60s catch timeout; §4/§8 make no promise of immediate native abort and keep TDLib-owned cache continuation as the documented ownership policy. §11 separates deterministic causal ordering (A1) from live-Telegram timing and labels simulated evidence as such. No clean-EOF-on-failure, no path-as-mechanism leak.

Non-blocking observations (no unimplementability/unreviewability, retained for the Implementer): (a) §7.4's unknown-size EOF path relies on the complete-state prefix query returning the true remaining length rather than an estimated Size; it is grounded in FileManager.cpp:1046-1050 but the Implementer's fake must model a Full location that reports actual remaining bytes, not a synthesized Size, so the A4 test binds the real behavior. (b) §10 step 2 mutates a single unique literal Synchronous:false; the design correctly requires failing if not exactly one match and forbids shipping a broken commit. (c) Historical path-only green CI (run 45630679946) is correctly labeled as proving only superseded code; A7 red/green must run on the reviewed streaming commit.
